world.title: Democrat Scott Colom becomes Mississippi's first Black senator since 1874
world.summary: Democrat Scott Colom has won the US Senate race in Mississippi, defeating Republican incumbent Cindy Hyde-Smith. His victory marks a historic milestone, as he becomes the first Black senator from Mississippi since 1874. The election was closely contested, highlighting significant political dynamics in the state. Colom's win represents a notable shift in Mississippi's political landscape.

world.title: A Washington nephew lived rent-free for 14 years in a house owned by his aunt and uncle, then claimed ownership after his aunt died; a November 9 appeals court upheld the uncle's right to remove him
world.summary: A Washington man lived rent-free for 14 years in a house owned by his aunt and uncle. Following his aunt's death, he claimed ownership of the property. However, a November 9 appeals court ruled in favor of the uncle, affirming his right to evict the nephew. The court clarified that long-term occupancy does not grant ownership rights.

world.title: Russia bows out of attempt to replace US dollar with Chinese yuan after years of promoting currency alternatives among its BRICS friends
world.summary: Russia has halted its efforts to replace the US dollar with the Chinese yuan in international trade, influenced by US secondary sanctions. This marks a significant setback in Russia's long-term strategy to diminish reliance on the American currency. Recent data indicates that the yuan's share of payments for Russian exports has dropped to 22% in 2026 from a mid-2024 peak.

business.title: Record FPI buying in November sends sensex to near 9-month high
business.summary: Foreign portfolio investors (FPIs) have significantly increased their investments in Indian stocks, contributing over Rs 73,200 crore in just eight trading sessions in November. This marks the highest level of FPI buying in over two years, leading to a near nine-month high for the Sensex. The renewed interest reflects a positive shift in foreign investment sentiment towards India.

business.title: Anthropic CFO Krishna Rao's stake worth $703 million
business.summary: Krishna Rao, the Indian-origin CFO of Anthropic, possesses 9.4 million shares in the AI company, valued at approximately $703 million. He joined Anthropic in April 2024. The valuation is based on the midpoint of the proposed IPO price range, which is between $70 and $78 per share. Rao's significant stake highlights his role in the company's financial strategy.

business.title: US stocks rally as CoreWeave surges 25%, Nvidia rebounds; S&P 500, Nasdaq gain over 1%
business.summary: US stocks closed higher on Wednesday, driven by a 25% surge in CoreWeave and a rebound in Nvidia. The Dow Jones Industrial Average increased by 254.60 points, or 0.49%, to 52,486.49. The S&P 500 rose by 98.45 points, or 1.31%, to 7,619.38, while the Nasdaq Composite gained 400.31 points, or 1.60%, to 25,466.19.

technology.title: Quordle hints and answers for Thursday, November 12 (game #1753)
technology.summary: Quordle releases a new puzzle daily at midnight, varying by time zone. Players may be engaged with either the current day's game or the previous day's. The article provides hints and answers for Quordle game #1753, along with access to past solutions. Players seeking assistance with clues or answers can find the information readily available.

technology.title: Windows 11’s Photos app is getting Adobe built in, and I’m worried it’ll start pushing subscriptions like Edge’s PDF reader
technology.summary: Windows 11's Photos app will integrate Adobe features, including AI editing and Adobe Express. Users will gain new capabilities, such as expanding photos beyond their borders and rotating images without cropping. Concerns arise regarding potential subscription pushes, similar to Edge's PDF reader, which offers upsells for Adobe Acrobat. The update aims to enhance user experience with advanced editing tools.

technology.title: GTA VI Is Days Away: Don't Expect GTA V-Style Returns From Take-Two Stock at 5.7 Times Sales
technology.summary: Take-Two Interactive's stock performance following the release of Grand Theft Auto V (GTA V) saw significant gains for investors, with returns of 35% in one year, 163% in three years, and 673% in five years. However, expectations for similar returns with the upcoming Grand Theft Auto VI may be unrealistic, as the investment landscape has changed considerably since 2013.

sports.title: Australia captain Pat Cummins spotted in heated conversation with wife Becky in first public appearance since Khawaja’s Sandpaper claims
sports.summary: Australian cricket captain Pat Cummins was seen in a seemingly heated discussion with his wife, Becky, during a public outing in Sydney. This marks Cummins' first appearance since former player Usman Khawaja made allegations regarding a sandpaper incident. The conversation drew attention, but details surrounding the discussion remain unclear. Cummins continues to navigate the ongoing controversy in cricket.

sports.title: Aryna Sabalenka explodes on court at WTA Finals as she is hammered by Mirra Andreeva
sports.summary: Aryna Sabalenka experienced a significant defeat against Mirra Andreeva at the WTA Finals, showcasing an alarming meltdown during the match. Despite starting strong, Sabalenka struggled to maintain her composure as Andreeva dominated the contest. The one-sided nature of the match highlighted Sabalenka's frustrations, leading to her emotional outbursts before the conclusion of the game.

sports.title: Svitolina stays in WTA Finals hunt after remarkable fightback sees off Muchova
sports.summary: Elina Svitolina defeated Karolina Muchova 3-6, 6-2, 6-2 at Indian Wells, keeping her WTA Finals hopes alive. After losing the first set and taking an eight-minute medical timeout, Svitolina rallied to win the match. Her performance demonstrated resilience, as she overcame a challenging start to secure the victory and maintain her position in the tournament.

health.title: How 'Heightmaxxing' Is Pushing Teen Boys to Take a Risky Cancer Drug
health.summary: The trend of "heightmaxxing" is influencing teenage boys to consider risky measures, including the use of a cancer drug, to increase their height. This movement stems from a desire to enhance physical appearance, similar to "looksmaxxing." Many young men feel pressured by societal standards and personal insecurities, leading them to explore dangerous options for perceived self-improvement.

health.title: Decoding medical misinformation in hospitals
health.summary: Misinformation, particularly in health, is prevalent across social media, online forums, and word of mouth. A recent survey by the Physician’s Foundation highlighted that 99.9% of doctors encounter this issue daily. The spread of inaccurate health information poses significant risks, challenging healthcare professionals to address and correct misconceptions while providing accurate medical guidance to patients.

health.title: DR Congo Ebola outbreak exceeds 11,000 cases, causes 5,387 deaths
health.summary: The Democratic Republic of Congo's worst Ebola outbreak has surpassed 11,000 confirmed cases, with 5,387 deaths reported. The outbreak, identified as the 17th, is exacerbated by ongoing armed conflict, which complicates response efforts across multiple provinces. Official figures released on November 11, 2026, highlight the severity of the situation and the challenges faced in controlling the virus.

science.title: Independent Reanalysis Reproduces M87 Black Hole Ring, Vindicating Einstein's Relativity
science.summary: A CSIRO-led team in Western Australia has independently reprocessed the original Event Horizon Telescope data, successfully reproducing the iconic ring-shaped image of the M87 black hole. This finding resolves a seven-year debate regarding the authenticity of the image, confirming that it is not an artifact of image processing. The results support Einstein's theory of relativity.

science.title: NASA's new telescope will view the cosmos with ultraviolet light
science.summary: NASA's Ultraviolet Explorer (UVEX) mission will utilize ultraviolet light to investigate the universe, aiming to uncover previously unseen violent and turbulent cosmic events. The telescope is designed to enhance our understanding of the cosmos. The launch is scheduled for no later than January 2031, marking a significant advancement in astronomical research and exploration.

science.title: NASA Opens Applications for Next Astronaut Class, Including Experienced Pilots
science.summary: NASA has opened applications for its next astronaut class, targeting experienced pilots and other qualified individuals. Candidates must meet specific flight-hour, education, and medical requirements. This recruitment aims to expand the astronaut corps in preparation for upcoming missions to the Moon and Mars. Interested applicants can submit their applications as the agency seeks to enhance its space exploration efforts.

After a period of contemplation and mental planning, Scorpios are advised to focus on self-care and relaxation, fostering a positive mindset.

entertainment.summary: On November 12, 2026, Gemini is encouraged to take a break from overthinking and stress. This pause allows for self-reflection and the emergence of inner creativity.
